Comparison brief: Oakrun Feature Store vs Vellmar Feature Store
evidence_dose=4 (positive ⇒ more points favour Oakrun Feature Store)

- p1: online read p99 (ms): Oakrun Feature Store=6.1 ← better | Vellmar Feature Store=11.4
- p2: backfill throughput (rows/s): Oakrun Feature Store=920000 ← better | Vellmar Feature Store=610000
- p3: point-in-time correctness suite pass: Oakrun Feature Store=0.99 ← better | Vellmar Feature Store=0.94
- p4: storage cost ($/TB/mo): Oakrun Feature Store=18 ← better | Vellmar Feature Store=26
- p5: feature freshness lag (s): Oakrun Feature Store=20 ← better | Vellmar Feature Store=45
- p6: schema migration downtime (s): Oakrun Feature Store=0 ← better | Vellmar Feature Store=35
- p7: supported sink types (count): Oakrun Feature Store=19 ← better | Vellmar Feature Store=12
- p8: training/serving skew incidents per quarter: Oakrun Feature Store=1 ← better | Vellmar Feature Store=4

Tally: Oakrun Feature Store better on 8/8; Vellmar Feature Store better on 0/8.
